A '''Sith male''' lived in the territory of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="The Voice of the Emperor" /> sometime during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[3950 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Near the end of his life, the [[Gender/Legends|man]] was utilized by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] as his [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice]].<ref name="The Voice of the Emperor" /> Like the other Voices, the elderly [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] male was eventually replaced with a new Voice when they [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="The Voice of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This Sith male was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Voice of the Emperor in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Voice of the Emperor" /> The [[Sith Warrior]] mission "The Voice of Darkness" confirms that the Voice must either die of natural causes or be killed in order to free the Emperor's essence, meaning that the Sith Voice must have died naturally or have been killed for the Emperor to have gained a new host.<ref name="The Voice of Darkness" />
